# Recorded native counter resets

Read-only capture on 2026-10-05 of the before/after token_count records from two real rollouts among the latest 400 local files. Only timestamps and usage objects are retained; no prompts, credentials or user content. July 5 shows a downward correction and September 5 a new cumulative epoch. Original files are unchanged. This isolated excerpt has no earlier history: its bill is the sum of its four last requests, not the full original sessions.

Pair 1: inclusive 422832, cached 421120, output 1148, reasoning 747; uncached 1712. Pair 2: inclusive 106893, cached 99968, output 656, reasoning 222; uncached 6925. At test rates .2 input, .02 read, 1.2 output per million: .01014240 + .00417156 = .01431396. Those rates are a hand-test oracle, not a claim about the original models' actual price. Tests duplicate each record to prove mirror suppression.
